svg.title: Drop-in speedup over jsdom per suite, warpdom and happy-dom
svg.text: Tuning suites (3 independent runs; 13 under the version rule)
happy-dom: no time in any round
Speedup over jsdom in each runner's default isolation (log scale), warpdom 208ad49. Bars: median of per-round ratios (tuning: 15 rounds of
three runs pooled; diamonds: each run's median); whiskers: range of the per-round ratios. † core on jsdom 16.7, outside the medians.
* every jsdom round flagged by the broken-round rule (21 tests reported or dropped on every DOM); raw rounds shown.
